SELECT c.c_nationkey AS nation_key, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count
FROM tpch.orders o
JOIN tpch.customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
GROUP BY c.c_nationkey
ORDER BY c.c_nationkey;
